unit: sum (whole external reticulation installation, one site, 3,000 m2 car park/yard, Auckland)

band.unit: sum (whole external reticulation installation, one site, 3,000 m2 car park/yard, Auckland)
band.basis: Lump sum, GST exclusive, NZD, Auckland. Additive build of 13 components in four rejectable parts: Part 1 trenching/sand/backfill/hardstand $11,002-$18,092; Part 2 conduit/draw cord/sub-main/terminations $50,480-$85,000; Part 3 pits $3,540-$5,800; Part 4 board/plinth/spurs $4,462-$6,732; Part 5 testing/CoC $900-$1,800. Centre ~$93,900. Implied over the 250 m nominal route: low ~$282/m, high ~$470/m, centre ~$376/m. Basis is QV CostBuilder rows (all unreviewed, caveated) plus labelled allowances (~11% of centre) for polymer pits, plinth, draw cord/bends, terminations, backfill compaction and CoC. Confidence LOW because the two largest components rest on unreviewed QV rows: the buried-conduit group has no 63 mm row and prices 100 mm cheaper than 50 mm, and no standard 4-core 25 mm2 XLPE/PVC cable row exists, so the sub-main is bracketed between an aluminium drawn-in-conduit row and a fire-rated copper row. Conduit is ~46% of the centre. Web search was rate-limited (HTTP 429), so no vendor/statutory page could be fetched; pits and CoC are allowances with suppliers named. This is a cost-plan band, not a certified price; it excludes GST, preliminaries, margin, design, consent fees, incoming supply/network, lighting poles/luminaires, and rock/contamination/dewatering/traffic management per scope.

band.unit: sum (whole external reticulation installation, one site)
band.basis: Lump sum, GST exclusive, Auckland, for the exact scope. Built from cited QV CostBuilder AKL rates (unreviewed) plus labelled allowances for minor items. Sub-totals: trenching & reinstatement $20,190-$26,280; conduit & cable $75,580-$89,905; pits $8,772-$10,872; board & spurs $4,026-$6,956. Allowances total about $5,600-$11,600, i.e. ~5-9% of the band. The largest component is the conduit (~45%), priced from the QV 50mm buried row as a proxy for 63mm, and the copper cable row wording is ambiguous (single core vs set of four) - hence low confidence. Implied $/lineal metre over the 250m nominal route: ~$434/m (low) to ~$536/m (high), centre ~$485/m. Excludes GST, preliminaries, margin, design and consent fees, incoming supply/network connection/transformer/main switchboard/metering, poles/footings/luminaires/controls/CCTV, rock/contaminated spoil/dewatering/traffic management, any second sub-main or generator/EV provision, and paving/kerbing/landscaping beyond the trench line. Web verification of the proprietary items was attempted but the search service was rate-limited, so the pit bodies and the IP66 board are allowances to be confirmed with suppliers.
